concerns.text: FR-001 (Download from NCBI GEO) and US-1 (Data Ingestion) lack complete task coverage. T010 is unchecked and explicitly marked as needing refinement to enforce 'Fail Loud' (T051), but no task exists to implement the actual download/fallback logic that produces `data/raw/raw_dataset.csv`. T012 (ordinal conversion) and T015 (harmonized output) are also unchecked, leaving the core data pipeline unimplemented.

FR-003 (Random Forest training) and FR-002 (PCA for p>>n) are not fully covered. T022 (Model training) is unchecked and marked 'FAILED: unspecified' in the analyze report. T020 (PCA reduction) is unchecked. Without these tasks, the predictive modeling requirement cannot be satisfied.

FR-005 (Permutation testing) and FR-006 (BH correction) have missing task coverage. T029a (Permutation logic) is unchecked and rejected in the analyze report. T032 (Correlation calculation) is unchecked. T047 (Integration test for validation) is unchecked. The statistical validation pipeline is incomplete.

SC-005 (Feasibility reporting) and US-3 (Null Result handling) lack implementation tasks. T048 (Report generation) and T049 (Null Result logic) are unchecked. T050 (Feasibility check) is unchecked. The final deliverable cannot be produced.

T057 references removing SVA logic to align with FR-007, but T029b (the task attempting SVA) was already rejected. This revision task is redundant and points to a non-existent implementation state, creating confusion about the current status of the batch effect control strategy.
